observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.observation: A useful finite implementation can disclose several operator-shaped continuations first, construct M25 R/A/P witnesses over each same forming movement, and let those witnesses participate in M255 Generated standing without collapsing either object into a score.
observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.formalization_question: What exact non-circular relation should connect movement construction, R/A/P readability, admissibility, and Generated accessibility when none is sovereign and more than one movement may remain live?

observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.observation: The same support-specific Fact9 expression participates in different Flourishing organizations and produces different continuation accessibility under capture or disguise. No one-to-one mapping is needed.
observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.formalization_question: Which bridge morphisms preserve the many-way Fact9/Flourishing joint while distinguishing semantic restoration from merely reattaching a favorable standing?

observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.observation: Participant independence becomes computationally material when same-lineage repetition remains proposal while different source/lineage support becomes a derived D relation and conflict becomes an inquiry-bearing relation.
observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.formalization_question: How should evidential independence, source identity, and relation transport compose without making corroboration a scalar or allowing a participant to acquire contact authority?

observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.observation: A consequence-bearing helix requires re-running the constitutive joint over K-prime. Appending consequence records without reconstructing possible continuations is observably weaker.
observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.formalization_question: What minimum preservation and transformation witnesses establish that K-prime remains the same becoming while its D/Omega/I/W/C, Flourishing expression, and accessibility have materially changed?

observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.observation: The complete Flourishing semantic records can remain causally attached to movement while finite trials supply typed standings. This proves the native consumer but not semantic recognition from language.
observations_for_later_26_6_and_26_9.formalization_question: What warrants and defeaters must a later grounding relation carry so that a language-derived capture or flourishing reading is neither an LLM verdict nor an empty label?

counterexamples_preserved: A carrier-supplied possible-movement can make a rich-looking Balance/RAP trace post-hoc; RR-002 prohibits that input shape.
One generated continuation plus neighbors in non-live standings is not evidence for two simultaneously Generated native alternatives.
Whole-checkpoint hash failure does not prove native recognition of a semantically severed but parseable constitutive organization.
Rejecting an entire contact because one participant record is malformed does not prove participant-local quarantine.
non_claim: These observations are PoC feedback. They do not amend, complete, prove, or supersede Inquiry 25, 25.5, 26.0, 26.3, or future Inquiry 26.6/26.9.
